order_wins: **Sathlokhar Synergys E&C Global** — bags **civil and PEB work at One Hub Chennai Park, Old Mahabalipuram Road, from Godrej Consumer Products, INR 44.26 crores including GST** _(~4.3% of mcap)_, for completion before February 2027. The Rs 22,654 crore in the same letter is its bid pipeline, not an order.

**Jyoti Global Plast** — receives **purchase orders aggregating Rs 8,62,66,015 from Paras Defence and Space Technologies** _(~10.8% of mcap)_ for precision components used in defence and aerospace imaging and sensor systems.

**Abha Power and Steel** — secures castings orders of **Rs 2,73,83,552 from a railway OEM it names only as "reputed"** _(~6.0% of mcap)_; its letter, dated 6 September, puts the order book at about Rs 24 crore.

**Eppeltone Engineers** — receives a **Rs 2,00,60,000 energy-meter supply order including taxes** _(~1.1% of mcap)_; the annexure names the buyer only as "Entity/ Organization" and states "Time period is not defined by the Entity".

**Accord Transformer & Switchgear** — takes **two 1000 KVA oil-transformer orders totalling Rs 1,92,39,000 excluding GST** _(~1.4% of mcap)_: Rs 1.43 crore from Ultra Mega Power and Rs 49.29 lakh from Ventora Energy, for delivery within three and two months.

**Skytech Infinite Platform** — receives **purchase orders of Rs 1,24,70,000 excluding GST** _(~3.2% of mcap)_ to design and commission PLCs for MTAR Technologies, Hyderabad; the awarding OEM's identity is withheld under a non-disclosure agreement.

**VA Tech Wabag** — secures a **repeat order from Reliance Industries for an effluent treatment plant at the Dhirubhai Ambani Green Energy Giga Complex, Jamnagar**, over 13 months. No value is given beyond its own "Medium" band, which it defines as Rs 100-250 crore.

**BCPL Railway Infrastructure** — is **lowest bidder for Eastern Railway's Asansol catenary and structure replacement, project cost Rs 54.74 crores including GST** _(~47.8% of mcap)_. Its own annexure reads "Lowest bidder but contract yet to be received".

**Oneindig Technologies** — emerges **L1 in NHPC's rooftop-solar tender for government buildings across five Haryana districts, aggregate estimated tender value Rs 140 crores**, at tariffs of Rs 3.45 to Rs 4.26 per kW. The filing says L1 "does not, by itself, constitute final award".

**GE Vernova T&D India** — is named **L1 bidder by Power Grid for a 6,000 MW, ±800 kV HVDC terminal station carrying renewable power from Barmer II to South Kalamb**. No value appears anywhere in the filing and no letter of award has been issued.

**ArisInfra Solutions** — its subsidiary ArisUnitern wins a **36-month Developer-as-a-Service order from O2 Spaces for "Morning Mist" in Whitefield, Bengaluru**, from 15 September. The Rs 280 crore in the filing is the project's gross development value, not a fee.

**Asian Energy Services** — reports that **Oilmax Energy, the company amalgamating into it, has an Arunachal Pradesh letter of intent for a composite licence over the 155.46-hectare Pakro vanadium and graphite block**. The filing states the LOI went to Oilmax, not to the company.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Party Cruisers** — its Rights Issue Committee fixes a **Rs 24 crore rights issue: 20,00,000 partly paid shares at Rs 120 payable in four tranches of Rs 30, one for every six held, record date 14 September** _(~25.1% of mcap)_, open 21 September to 5 October.

**Digikore Studios** — approves a **preferential issue of equity to an identified promoter and an authorised-capital increase to Rs 18 crore, both subject to shareholder approval**, and rescinds an earlier resolution raising that capital to Rs 17 crore. No share count or price is in the cached pages.

**Variman Global Enterprises** — **withdraws** the 29 August acquisition of Ecogenics Technologies, a 41,07,42,006-share swap at Rs 4.65, and the authorised-capital increase with it, because the selling shareholders' PAN details were never supplied.
equity_allotments: **Jainik Power Cables** — allots **30,00,000 warrants at Rs 151.50, Rs 45.45 crore in all** _(~15.1% of mcap)_, to 18 allottees including promoters and Arthasanchay Growth Fund, on 25% upfront of Rs 11,36,25,000; paid-up capital is unchanged until conversion.

**Unihealth Hospitals** — allots **12,50,000 shares at Rs 520.31, Rs 65.04 crore, for consideration other than cash** _(~5.7% of mcap)_ — a share swap buying 2,55,544 shares of Victoria Hospital from two non-promoter Kotecha allottees.

**Tirupati Forge** — allots **37,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 58, Rs 21.46 crore** _(~2.4% of mcap)_, entirely to three promoter and promoter-group allottees, on 25% upfront of Rs 5,36,50,000 and exercisable within 18 months.

**Bal Pharma** — allots **10,00,000 warrants at Rs 84, Rs 8.40 crore, to promoter Shailesh Siroya** _(~6.0% of mcap)_ on 25% upfront of Rs 2,10,00,000, lifting him from 17.24% to 20.89% fully diluted.

**Cubical Financial Services** — allots a **first tranche of 2,89,00,000 shares at Rs 2.50, Rs 7.22 crore, to four promoter-group allottees** _(~19.8% of mcap)_ taking 31% of post-issue capital, with RBI approval for the change in NBFC control granted 31 August.

**Milkfood** — allots **22,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 30 to two non-promoter allottees**, Sudhir Avasthi and Deepankar Barat, 11,00,000 each, on 25% upfront of Rs 7.50 a warrant; the filing states no aggregate and paid-up capital is unchanged.

**Shipwaves Online** — applies to BSE for in-principle approval for a **proposed 3,33,20,000 convertible warrants at Rs 4.50, Rs 14,99,40,000**, which still needs shareholder and regulatory approval; nothing is issued yet.

**Thomas Cook (India)** — its Mauritius subsidiary is allotted **990 shares of step-down PT Asian Trails Indonesia against an Indonesian Rupiah 712,800,000 rights subscription made on 3 August**, leaving its stake unchanged at 66%. No rupee equivalent is stated.
m_and_a: **Novartis India** — acquires the **Indian trademarks 'Minipress' and 'Minipres' and related IP from Pfizer Inc. USA and Pfizer Products Inc. USA for INR 1250,00,10,000** _(~21.2% of mcap)_, the asset purchase agreement and assignment deeds signed and closed the same day.

**Solarworld Energy Solutions** — signs a subscription and joint-venture agreement to take **50% of Rays Green Energy Manufacturing alongside Rays Power Infra, for a 2.4 GW solar cell plant at Mohasa, Madhya Pradesh**, and redirects its IPO proceeds into it. No investment figure is stated.

**Transworld Shipping Lines** — approves buying **two container vessels from Orient Express Lines, 'OEL SURYA' at USD 22.03 million and 'OEL VARUN' at USD 20.75 million**, through an IFSC subsidiary. Buyer and seller are under common control; no rupee equivalent is stated.

**Swiggy** — sells **Lynks Logistics, holding its B2B distribution business, to Singapore's Trustroot Internet for 166,534 Series R preference shares at USD 314.40 each**, a pure share swap closing about 22 October. The business turned over Rs 668 crore last year.

**63 moons technologies** — its Singapore subsidiary FTSPL subscribes **Rs 70 crore to a preferential issue by Ticker Ltd, already a 63 moons subsidiary**, lifting the group holding to 65.80% with "no change in control"; the filing calls it a material related-party transaction.

**Anupam Rasayan India** — approves buying **2,60,065 shares of subsidiary Tanfac Industries at Rs 2,341 each, Rs 60,88,12,165 in all** _(~0.4% of mcap)_, on a preferential basis, accepting Tanfac's private-placement offer of 3 September.

**Adani Power** — is **declared successful resolution applicant for GVK Energy and has the letter of intent**, received 9:35 a.m., for a company owning a 330 MW Uttarakhand hydro plant through Alaknanda Hydro Power. No consideration is disclosed.

**Vishnu Chemicals** — executes a joint-venture agreement with **France's DCX Chrome SAS for a 50:50 company building a 6,000 TPA high-purity chromium metal plant at Visakhapatnam**, initially capitalised at just Rs 1,00,000 between them.

**Aro Granite Industries** — approves the **slump sale of its Mahindra World City (Jaipur) SEZ unit**, which contributed Rs 11.96 crore of turnover and carries Rs 48.19 crore of book value, on a non-binding MoU subject to postal ballot. No buyer and no price are named.

**Bhagyanagar India** — the **NCLT Hyderabad allows its composite scheme of arrangement**, moving Bhagyanagar Copper into the company and demerging a business into Tieramet, in CP (CAA) No.14/230/HDB/2026.

**Chalet Hotels** — **completes the purchase of 100% of Lakeview Mercantile**, which owns a Bambolim land parcel in Goa with potential for a 170-room luxury resort. The consideration was disclosed in its 12 May 2025 intimation, not restated here.

**Capital Trade Links** — acquires **1,49,999 shares, 16.36% of Rhythms Industries, for cash**; the Rs 103.68 crore in the annexure is the target's FY26 revenue, and the price falls past the end of the cached pages.

**Info Edge (India)** — invests **about Rs 10 crore in Startup Investments (Holding), already its wholly owned subsidiary**, taking 3,357,958 shares of Rs 10 face value at a Rs 19.78 premium; the filing confirms SIHL "remains the wholly-owned subsidiary".

**Titagarh Rail Systems** — agrees with **Italy's Mermec S.p.A. to conclude their 50:50 joint venture Titagarh Mermec and close the company**, which the filing says is presently non-operational, so there is no impact.

⚑ **Sar Televenture** — **withdraws its NSE application for 1,26,06,000 shares and cancels the share purchase agreement of 29 October 2024** for Tikona Infinet, blaming "inordinate delay in obtaining the requisite approval" _(⚑ content disagrees with the subject tag)_.

⚑ **B&B Triplewall Containers** — **disinvests its entire 27% stake in Sharvesh Power Projects** after rescinding the power purchase agreement behind it; the annexure records no buyer, no price and no agreement date _(⚑ content disagrees with the subject tag)_.

**Axtel Industries** — licenses from **IISc's Foundation for Science, Innovation and Development the technology for a cryogenic counter-rotating pin-disc impact mill**, paying up to Rs 3 crore for the prototype and royalties capped at a further Rs 3 crore.
**Glottis** — incorporates a **wholly owned Malaysian subsidiary, Glottis Logistics SDN. BHD.**, capitalised at 1,000 shares of RM 1 each with nil turnover.

⚑ **Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products** — its **unsecured creditors passed the demerger of Jubilant Agri Solutions "with requisite majority"** at the NCLT-convened meeting of 5 September, per the scrutinizer's report _(⚑ content disagrees with the subject tag)_.

**Marathon Nextgen Realty** — holds the **NCLT-convened equity shareholders' and unsecured creditors' meetings on its seven-company composite amalgamation scheme**; the filing says voting results and the scrutinizer's report "will be submitted separately".

**Garuda Construction and Engineering** — its subsidiary Dream City Builders signs a **non-binding MoU with Almasarat Company for a 93-storey tower in Jeddah**, which the filing calls an estimated revenue potential of about Rs 1,800 crore over five years, subject to approvals and commencement.

**RNFI Services** — signs a **three-year non-financial MoU with the Assam State Rural Livelihoods Mission Society** to make self-help-group members banking correspondents; the filing states it involves no monetary consideration whatever.

**Gujarat Natural Resources** — resumes **appraisal and development drilling with two rigs**, having drilled five wells in the pre-monsoon campaign, and says acquisition talks are at an advanced stage without naming a target.

**India Glycols** — forwards a letter from **Ennature Bio Pharma disclosing material updates**, as the exchanges' observation letters on its scheme of arrangement require. The annexure content falls past the end of the cached pages.
capex_core: **Neuland Laboratories** — approves **Rs 126 crore of capital expenditure to buy about 134 acres at Auro Industrial City, Kakinada**, from internal accruals, with a right of first refusal over 66 acres more. Its annexure states capacity addition "N/A" — this buys land, not capacity.

**Morepen Laboratories** — completes the **first phase of its capacity expansion ahead of schedule, lifting installed API and CDMO reactor capacity from 535 KL to 614 KL**. No investment figure is stated.

**Max Healthcare Institute** — is allotted **50,21,212 shares in subsidiary Kalinga Hospital on a rights basis**, completing the roughly Rs 87.87 crore infusion it disclosed on 3 September and taking its stake from 58.28% to 66.15%.
business_updates: **Results season** — 12 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Jindal Stainless** — signs a **technical assistance agreement with Japan's JFE Steel for selected ferritic stainless grades**. The filing states no value; the Rs 42,955 crore beside it is Jindal's own FY26 turnover, quoted in the release's "About the Company" footer.

**Symphony** — will **enter room air conditioners, BLDC ceiling fans and air purifiers from the December 2026 quarter**, on an asset-light model with "no current plan to invest in in-house manufacturing capacity", funded from internal accruals.

**Tata Consultancy Services** — opens a **4,500 sq ft AI-native creative engineering studio in London**, part of a commitment it states as 5,000 new jobs across the region over three years. No investment figure is given.

**Chandan Healthcare** — will ask members to **redeploy Rs 50 crore of unutilised proceeds from its November 2025 warrant issue**, away from buying business units and into new diagnostic laboratories and comprehensive diagnostic centres.
distress_risk: **Prism Johnson** — the **CESTAT New Delhi sets aside an Rs 11.53 crore excise demand, including Rs 6.04 crore of penalty**, raised by the Jabalpur Commissionerate and first disclosed in August 2023. The written order is not yet uploaded.

**Radaan Mediaworks** — the **CESTAT Chennai sets aside a Rs 5,32,43,696 CENVAT credit demand with interest and penalties** _(~33.1% of mcap)_, allowing all three of its 2017 service-tax appeals with consequential relief.
**JSW Dulux** — the **Karnataka GST department refunds Rs 10,81,413 and annuls a Rs 9,89,064 penalty** imposed in December 2024 under section 129(3), after allowing the company's appeal.

**Mankind Pharma** — members of wholly owned **Bharat Serums and Vaccines approve its voluntary liquidation**, subject to creditors' approval under the insolvency code, continuing the process it flagged on 26 August.

**Shri Ram Switchgears** — implements its **NCLT-approved resolution plan: 60,87,585 promoter shares cancelled, 39,22,980 public shares cut to 25,000, and Rs 47,50,000 of fresh equity to Alaknanda Consultancy**, which becomes a 95% promoter. Record date 16 September.

**3i Infotech** — deregisters dormant step-down subsidiary **3i Infotech Netherlands B.V. from the Dutch trade register on 3 September**, with effect from 30 April 2026; the filing gives the reason for closure as "Dormant entity".
**SKIL Infrastructure** — under insolvency since February 2024, gives prior intimation that its **eleventh committee of creditors meeting will be held on 9 September**.
**Sun Granite Export** — its **committee of creditors unanimously appoints Raghunath Bhandari as resolution professional** at its meeting of 3 September, under section 22(2) of the insolvency code.
other_notable: **PVR Inox** — files the **letter of offer for its Rs 300 crore buyback: up to 20,68,965 shares at Rs 1,450, 2.11% of capital, tendering open 10 to 17 September** on a 4 September record date. Small shareholders get 9 shares for every 157 held.
